title: Multi-agent
intro: A second agent is a tool. delegate runs another run_agent with its own messages. The parent list only receives the string that tool returns.

steps.author: system
steps.label: System
steps.text: Delegate research and coding. Then answer.
steps.narration: The parent loop has one tool, delegate. Calling it starts a child agent.

steps.author: user
steps.label: User
steps.text: Compare Atlas and Beacon. Plan the switch.
steps.narration: The user wants a comparison and a plan. Those are two jobs, so the parent can call delegate twice.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call

events: parent -> researcher: Compare Atlas and Beacon.

steps.narration: delegate starts researcher. That child has its own empty message list. The parent waits.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.text: Beacon has the smaller API and supports the required region.
steps.narration: The child loop finished. Only its return string is appended to the parent list. The child's messages stay private.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call

events: parent -> coder: Plan the switch to Beacon.

steps.narration: The parent calls delegate again, this time for coder. That child also starts with an empty list.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.text: Pin beacon>=2.1 and remove atlas from requirements.
steps.narration: The coder's messages stay private. The parent list gets one more string.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Assistant
steps.text: Switch to Beacon. Pin beacon>=2.1 and drop Atlas.
steps.narration: The parent answers from those two tool results. It never received the child message lists.
